Comprehensive tests will be conducted before considering an increase to E25 petrol or beyond. Puri emphasized the importance of an established ecosystem for successful blending. He also addressed the availability of LPG cylinders and promoted Piped Natural Gas as a more economical alternative.

items.title: NLMC eyes Rs 1,300 crore fresh asset monetisation from BSNL, MTNL
items.summary: The National Land Monetization Corporation Ltd is considering asset monetisation for Bharat Sanchar Nigam Ltd and Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd. This new initiative is valued at Rs 1,300 crore, expanding previous successful monetisation efforts. NLMC has already monetised assets worth over Rs 9,000 crore this financial year. The corporation is also looking at residential properties in New Delhi and Mumbai to unlock additional value.

items.title: Govt approves 19,983 health infrastructure units under PM-ABHIM
items.summary: The government has approved a significant number of health infrastructure units aimed at enhancing public health services. This initiative specifically targets disease surveillance, emergency preparedness, and healthcare delivery alongside critical care capabilities. Established through the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission, it seeks to bolster the healthcare framework across the country. Various facilities, including Ayushman Arogya Mandirs and Public Health Units, will contribute to improving access to essential services.

items.title: Capital goods, strategic manufacturing sectors to generate 50 lakh jobs over next five years: CGSSC
items.summary: The Capital Goods & Strategic Skill Council emphasized the projected creation of 50 lakh job opportunities in India. These jobs will primarily be in capital goods and strategic manufacturing sectors over the next five years. There is a significant demand for skilled workers in various technical roles such as riggers and CNC operators. Advanced manufacturing and automation training are crucial to meet this demand effectively.

items.title: Air India’s new CEO announces $650 million cost-cutting plan with flight reshuffle, dept mergers
items.summary: Air India is implementing several measures to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs. CEO Tewolde Gebremariam is focused on saving 60 billion rupees within the year. The airline plans to merge departments and introduce new holiday packages for customers. Additionally, certain flights will shift from New Delhi to Mumbai and Bengaluru to improve routes. These initiatives aim to address significant financial losses and ongoing operational challenges.

items.title: Even 17% tariff under India-US trade deal may offer little competitive advantage to Indian exporters: FIEO
items.summary: Ajay Sahai from the Federation of Indian Export Organisations expressed concerns about a potential BTA with the US. He mentioned that even a 17 per cent tariff concession may not give Indian exporters an advantage. Competing nations, particularly in Southeast Asia, could secure better trade terms through their own agreements. Sahai estimated an 8 per cent additional cost burden for exporters if US tariffs rise to 25 per cent.

items.title: India attracts $31 bn in climate equity funding, but $22-24 trn needed by 2070: BCG-IVCA
items.summary: India has secured nearly USD 31 billion in climate funding since 2021, focusing primarily on power and transport. Underfunded sectors such as manufacturing, waste management, and agriculture require significant investment to meet future goals. The country needs approximately USD 22 trillion in total investment by 2070 to support climate transition. Improving investment viability through innovative financing structures has been identified as a crucial step.

items.title: Govt projects Kharif foodgrain production at 167.14 mln tonnes despite El Nino; 2025-26 crop output a record
items.summary: Kharif foodgrain production for the 2026-27 crop year is projected at 167.14 million tonnes amid weather challenges. Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced these estimates despite El Nino and a delayed monsoon. In the previous crop year, foodgrain production reached a record high of 378.54 million tonnes. Additionally, pulses and oilseeds are being prioritized due to India's reliance on imports.
